xml.log: If there is an update when the file file is missing, go to Steam Client - Library List - mydockfinder - right-click menu - Properties - Local File - Verify software file integrity If the desktop icon is not displayed after enabling pre-stage scheduling, you can right-click on the desktop-view-display desktop icon to enable display desktop icon Changelog ·Added dock background liquid glass configuration. You need to manually add dockbgtype=1 under [normal] in config.ini. After restarting, the dock background liquid glass effect can be enabled. ·Brand new compilation method, program instruction set changed to AVX. ·Completely new dock icon rendering method, high-quality icon rendering removed. In this version, rendering is always high-quality, fully GPU-accelerated, fixing all previous versions' icon residue and other rendering issues. ·Fixed the previous issue where leaving the dock from the left side without icon magnification enabled caused text labels and icon selection effects to be misaligned. ·Optimized minimized window animation shadow rendering, using D3D11HLSL to render shadows, improving performance and reducing video memory usage. ·Fixed the previous version's dock icon scaling and global scaling configuration reading error. ·Fixed the previous version's dock icon loss issue. ·Adapted to WeChat Mini Programs. Each mini program can display an independent icon and can also be added to the dock with WeChat Mini Program binding. ·Fixed the previous version's issue where adding a general icon would cause the window to freeze after clicking add. ·Fixed the issue in the previous version where front scheduling on multiple screens could cause the program to freeze. ·Fixed the front scheduling issue where continuously switching windows could cause a certain window to disappear from the window list. ·Fixed the high CPU usage problem caused by recycling bin detection due to a large number of disk partitions on some systems. ·Fixed the incorrect icon sorting order issue when saving in MyFinder. ·Fixed activation issues for some program tray icon menus. ·Optimized the Launchpad icon rendering, separating text and icons to save GPU usage. ·Optimized the Launchpad drag-and-swap icon order feature.
